rules: All entries require an actual invocation/read with result and return-type evidence.
Expr entries require both eager select and LazyFrame collect; constructing an Expr alone is insufficient.
An error is a valid example only for a documented unsupported input/protocol or actual contract error; it does not prove supported success.
Applicable semantic dimensions need an explicit scenario mapping; non-applicable reasons are recorded per entry.
Candidate passes are invalidated and rerun against the final newest release.
